name: Codebase Memory — code intelligence
description: Enrolls DeusData/codebase-memory-mcp (MIT) as an aish MCP server, exposing 14 structural code-intelligence tools (get_architecture, search_graph, query_graph, trace_path, get_code_snippet, detect_changes, manage_adr, index_repository, …). aish auto-merges this plugin's .mcp.json into the MCP client set, so the server connects with no manual edit to ~/.aish/.mcp.json. Ships a code-intelligence skill and an auto-index-on-repo-open gate.
author: LightHeart Ventures

mcp.note: aish merges every plugin's <plugin>/.mcp.json into the MCP client set (first-one-wins precedence: project config > user config > plugin, plugins in id order). No mcpServers entry in ~/.aish/.mcp.json is required for the server to connect once this plugin is installed.

autoIndex.description: Warm the repo's structural graph once per repo-open (bounded, backgrounded) so code-intelligence queries are ready before the first coordinator turn.
autoIndex.resolutionOrder: env override (AISH_CODEBASE_AUTO_INDEX) -> codebaseMemory.autoIndex bool in ~/.aish/.mcp.json -> ON by default
autoIndex.enrollmentCaveat: The repo-open auto-index handoff also checks is_enrolled() against ~/.aish/.mcp.json (mcpServers.codebase-memory). Serving the tools via this plugin makes them AVAILABLE, but auto-index stays dormant unless that enrollment entry is present in ~/.aish/.mcp.json (e.g. via ':codebase install') OR a newer aish teaches the probe to consult plugin .mcp.json. Manual `index_repository` calls work either way. See docs/plugins/codebase-memory-plugin.md.
